title: Columbia annual OpenAlex field counts, 2021–2024
description: One row per publication year and OpenAlex field ID (all 26 taxonomy fields, zero-filled) or explicit Unassigned bucket (NULL field ID). Counts distinct snapshot work IDs across all types for Columbia University I78577930 and snapshot-defined children, using works.primary_topic_id joined to topics; no topic fallback.
code: WITH years AS (SELECT year AS publication_year FROM range(2021,2025) AS y(year)), field_dim AS (SELECT DISTINCT field_id, field AS field_name, false AS is_unassigned FROM topics UNION ALL SELECT NULL::VARCHAR, 'Unassigned', true), counts AS (SELECT w.publication_year, t.field_id, count(DISTINCT w.work_id) AS work_count FROM works w LEFT JOIN topics t ON w.primary_topic_id=t.topic_id WHERE w.publication_year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2024 GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT y.publication_year, f.field_id, f.field_name, f.is_unassigned, coalesce(c.work_count,0) AS work_count FROM years y CROSS JOIN field_dim f LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.publication_year=y.publication_year AND c.field_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.field_id ORDER BY y.publication_year, f.is_unassigned, f.field_id
